mEq works like mgElectrolytes

mEq counts charge, so calcium counts twice.

ProductmEq/mL10 mL
Calcium chloride 10%1.3613.6
Calcium gluconate 10%0.464.6
Bicarb 8.4%110
KCl concentrate220
Saline 0.9%0.1541.5
Saline 3%0.5135.1
Saline 7.5%1.2812.8

Gluconate carries a third of the calcium in chloride, so three amps of gluconate equal one amp of chloride. For saline, mEq/L = g/L ÷ 58.5 × 1000.

AboutLazarus

Paramedic prep that brings it all back, from Sanguine Solutions. Per Constantiam, Vincimus.
